_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 534a7a46, req 675cb0ab-b73d-4736-934d-6094e792af5d — SUBJECT: packages/core/src/services/DeclaredRangesResolver.ts. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute; the driver copies the tree with node_modules symlinked, splices ONE mutation into the copy's subject and runs the suites named in `harness`; `expect` names the axes that MUST go red). Guards enumerated from `git diff -U0` (integration-test-revert-verify §A8). ⛤ MR3/MR3b are the PAIR that makes the choice of inverse addressable rather than asserted (ORCH plan-gate 2026-09-20): MR3 swaps iriToObsidianName for the static-map reversal and must redden K4 (namespace `team`, ABSENT from the nine-namespace map MR3 inlines — that map was retired from FrontmatterService (retired by ticket 6572f3f3 / req 38e3f174), so MR3 now reproduces a HISTORICAL alternative rather than a live one, and still discriminates) while leaving K16 (`ems`, present) green — an axis written on an in-map namespace would be green under BOTH derivations and prove nothing about the 81 of 104 typing definitions the static map misses. ⛔ NAMED, not mutated (integration-test-revert-verify §A35): the IRI-label fallback is DEFENSIVE on today's data — all 485 ranged definitions carry an rdfs:label literal (measured 2026-09-20, vault-exodev), so no live definition reaches it; MR2/MR3 therefore pin a path that only a synthetic definition takes, and that is stated rather than dressed up as live coverage. The load-bearing read is rdfs:label itself, which MR1b removes.

MR1_literal_label_branch_removed._note: Type-PRESERVING by construction (integration-test-revert-verify §A36): the `instanceof Literal` narrowing stays, only the SET is dropped. The first form of this mutant wrapped the branch in `if (false)` and killed the narrowing — tsc TS2339 `Property 'value' does not exist on type 'Object'`, which the driver reports as BROKEN, i.e. no verdict at all. ⛤ Only K3 reddens: it is the one fixture whose label is a literal on exo__Asset_label with no rdfs:label, so nothing else can key it. The live-form fixtures fall through to the IRI inverse and stay green — see MR1c for why that is redundancy, not a hole.

MR1b_rdfs_label_not_read._note: ⛔ MEASURED ZERO, and the measurement CORRECTS this spec's first reading of its own subject. The claim was that reading rdfs:label is THE load-bearing derivation because the converter emits exo__Asset_label as a symbolic IRI in 478 of 485 live definitions. The first half is measured and stands; the conclusion did not: a live-form definition carries BOTH the symbolic IRI and the rdfs:label literal, so with rdfs:label unread the key still resolves through the IRI inverse. The two reads are REDUNDANT on the live shape — either alone suffices — which makes this guard 'under test twice' rather than untested (§A43). MR1c is the pair-mutant that kills both and shows the pair IS load-bearing. Kept as a separate entry because a future definition carrying only one of the two would make this mutant discriminate.

MR2_iri_label_branch_removed._note: Type-PRESERVING (§A36): the `instanceof IRI` narrowing stays, only the SET is dropped; the first form appended `&& false` to the condition and killed the narrowing (tsc TS2339 → the driver reports BROKEN, i.e. no verdict). ⛤ MEASURED ['K16','K4'] — the two iri-only fixtures, exactly as first predicted. ⚠ Recorded because the prediction was briefly WITHDRAWN on the strength of the BROKEN run: with no verdict available I reasoned the axes must be green by redundancy and set expect to []. That inference was wrong, and only the type-preserving re-run could say so — 'BROKEN' is the absence of a measurement, and treating it as one is how a real discriminating mutant gets written off as defensive.

MR3_inverse_swapped_for_the_static_prefi._note: ⛤ THE addressability pair with K16, required by the ORCH plan-gate. The replacement reproduces the OUTCOME that FrontmatterService.normalizeIRI had while it carried a static nine-namespace IRI_PREFIX_MAP — exactly these nine namespaces, and for anything else the IRI UNCHANGED, which is what the untouched `symbolic` is here. ⛤ That map was retired (retired by ticket 6572f3f3 / req 38e3f174); the mutant inlines its own copy, so it keeps discriminating as a historical alternative. Inlined rather than imported because the driver splices ONE mutation per copy, so a mutant needing a second edit (the import) would report BROKEN instead of a verdict (mutant-driver trap 2). Must redden K4 (`team`, absent from the inlined nine) and leave K16 (`ems`, present in them) GREEN — an axis on one of those nine is green under BOTH inverses and would prove nothing about the 81 of 104 typing definitions such a map missed.

MR4_first_wins_dropped_last_def_wins.from: if (out.has(key)) continue; // first-wins, as PropertyNameValidator does
MR4_first_wins_dropped_last_def_wins.to: if (out.has(key) && false) continue; // first-wins, as PropertyNameValidator does
MR4_first_wins_dropped_last_def_wins._note: K6 seeds two definitions under one label with DIFFERENT ranges, so last-wins flips its expected value.

MR5_unresolvable_label_admitted_as_empty.from: if (key === null || key === undefined || key.length === 0) continue;
MR5_unresolvable_label_admitted_as_empty._note: ⛔ MEASURED ZERO ⇒ DEFENSIVE, named rather than dressed as coverage (§A35). K7's unlabelled seed yields `null` from the key derivation, which the `=== null` arm catches, so the `length === 0` arm is reachable only for a definition whose label literal is an EMPTY string — a shape no fixture here builds and none of the 485 live ranged definitions has. Kept because a whitespace-only label would otherwise become a map key.

MR6_multi_valued_range_collapsed_to_firs._note: ⛤ Pinned by K17, which was ADDED because this mutant first reddened nothing: the file had no fixture whose range carries two values, so the accumulation branch (`acc.push`) was never taken and the guard was unpinnable. The axis is synthetic and says so — multi-valued ranges measure 0 / 0 / 0 across the three vaults — but the guard is what lets scalarTypingForRange see two values and decline to type, which is the fail-open half of the declared-range rule.

MR7_non_IRI_range_subject_admitted._note: ⛔ DEFENSIVE, and a type-preserving mutant is IMPOSSIBLE here by construction: this guard IS the narrowing that makes `t.subject.value` below type-check, so any mutation that removes its effect removes the narrowing and the copy stops compiling (measured: tsc TS2339 `Property 'value' does not exist on type 'Subject'` ⇒ the driver reports BROKEN, which is the absence of a verdict, not a verdict). The `from`/`to` are kept for the record; `expect: []` states that this guard cannot be pinned by this instrument rather than pretending it is covered.

MR1c_neither_label_predicate_read._note: ⛤ THE pair-mutant MR1b's zero demanded (§A43): neither label predicate is read, so no definition can be keyed at all and every axis of this file loses its subject. This is what makes the PAIR load-bearing where neither half is alone. Wide by construction, and the width is the verdict, not noise.
